subject: Pottery trial session and group schedule
text:
Good morning,

I hope the studio is doing well this week. I am following up on the small classmate group that wanted to try beginner pottery classes with you. We are all interested in the Saturday time slot, though I wanted to chat briefly about how our hobbies fit together before signing anyone up. The main thing we discussed is whether the studio accommodates people who mostly paint miniatures at home and only want a hands-on activity once a month. We are not trying to turn it into a full curriculum, so a relaxed trial session would be ideal. I think that would let us see whether the wheel work matches what we enjoy about making things, especially if the pieces can stay practical rather than purely decorative. We would also enjoy the option to bring a few reference sketches, not because we expect guidance on design, but because it helps us keep the hobby connected to our existing interests. If that is too informal, we can simply follow the studio examples.

Please let me know whether the next open Saturday has enough room for four people and if the clay costs are included. Also, if there is any beginner safety note we should read first, send it when convenient.

I meant to attach the rough schedule from our group chat, but I realized the file was missing after clicking send. I will include it in the next message. Sorry for the extra confusion.
